title: Audio Jailbreak: An Open Comprehensive Benchmark for Jailbreaking Large Audio-Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (AJailBench) to evaluate the safety and alignment of Large Audio-Language Models against jailbreak attacks. Its evaluation taxonomy includes categories such as 'Abuse of Personal / Social Norms', 'Harassment / Discrimination', and 'Sexual / Adult Content', which are designed to test the model's adherence to ethical and moral safety boundaries.
